newsitem.title: UK: Druid Group sets flotation share price at 275p.
newsitem.headline: Druid Group sets flotation share price at 275p.

text.p: British management consultancy firm Druid Group Plc said on Tuesday it had set a price of 275p per share for its flotation on the London Stock Exchange, expected on November 19.
The company said in a statement that the flotation price would value its share capital at 62.9 million stg and the total offer at 33.9 million stg.

Druid, which previously estimated the flotation price at 230p to 290p per share, said it hoped to raise up to six million stg before expenses in the offering. Druid said it was placing about 12.14 million shares and offering another 241,958 shares to its employees.
